result.recommendation: Hold Step 5 finalization and perform one reproducible pre-finalization gate covering TypeScript compilation plus automated checks of changed-path scope, production dependency count, and the 200-line module limit.
result.rationale: The reported 32 passing tests support behavioral correctness, but the supplied evidence does not independently demonstrate every invariant. In particular, no type-check result, changed-file inventory, dependency audit, line-count output, or review artifact substantiates the summary claims. This bounded gate is cheaper and safer than reopening implementation review and should resolve the remaining approval gap.
cautions: Do not expand the gate into backend, React UI, or packaging work.
If the apparent singular/plural protocol import paths in the excerpts are intentional, compilation should confirm their validity; otherwise they may indicate an unresolved module-path defect.
Passing tests alone may not expose declaration, module-resolution, or unexercised type errors.
assumptions: The quoted test counts and 9.5/10 review score are accurate but currently lack attached artifacts.
Only the eight authorized paths are intended to have changed.
The project has an existing non-emitting TypeScript validation command or equivalent.
Zero root production dependencies means Phase 05 introduced no new production dependency at the repository root.
success_checks: The relevant TypeScript project compiles with no errors and without emitting files.
The changed-file list contains no path outside the eight authorized paths.
The root production dependency baseline is unchanged.
Every changed source module is under 200 lines.
The three reported suites still total 32 passed and 0 failed.
The finalization record includes reproducible outputs or artifacts for these checks and the 9.5/10 review disposition.
